```{r}
#| include: false
source("caption.R"); clag_install()
mode <- Sys.getenv("CAP_MODE", "after")
if (mode == "after") clag_install_captions() else if (mode == "early") clag_install_captions_early()
n_sites <- 5; depth <- 0.62; slope <- 0.3; tier <- "sev"
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-q1
#| fig-cap: 'Q1 single-quoted: mean `r depth`{.dec1 claim=". > 0.5"} m, [severe | mild]{if="tier == ''sev''"}.'
plot(1:3)
```

#| label: fig-q2
